transcript.text: Have you ever seen success create more
pressure instead of less?
>> I think the perception of pressure stays
the same. I think you become more able
to handle it. Like the things that
stressed you out when you were a
5-year-old probably don't stress you out
anymore, but they were probably very
stressful as a 5-year-old because you
had these skills and coping mechanisms
of a 5-year-old. But that's why the
goal, I think, for me has always been
like become someone capable of handling
those stressors the same way I can
handle the current ones I have. So, it's
like, oh my god, those dragons are so
big. It's like, well, someday I'll have
a sword that's bigger enough and a
shield that's strong enough that I can
battle
